allowedNonSemanticOperations: policy enforcement based on path names and roles
forbiddenForTrainingSourceAudit.policy: Training-source audit/design must exclude final-test sources before semantic content access, sealed-record search/read, hashing, probing, decoding, extraction, or content-derived inspection. Non-semantic existence/path-role checks are allowed for policy enforcement. Alias checks may use already-recorded registry identifiers and SHA values only.

sources.autopsyInputEligibilityCondition: only after v5 selected.pt is frozen

DEVELOPMENT_VALIDATION.policy: Allowed for checkpoint selection with predeclared equal-source macro weighting; never train.

EXCLUDED_OR_AMBIGUOUS.policy: Not train eligible for v5_e01 design. Ants11 is an alias of own_colony_val_001 and remains never-train; Ants2 is too short/auxiliary; ant3 is qualitative stress only.

FINAL_TEST.policy: No active strict V5 final test is registered after DEVELOPMENT_GT_METADATA_EXPOSURE. A replacement strict final test is required before any V5 final evaluation.

OBSERVED_REFERENCE.policy: Observed references only. Never train, never checkpoint-select, never threshold-tune. May be rerun only after selected.pt is frozen. former_v5_final_test_001 remains sealed from V5 development until v5 selected.pt is frozen.

sources.autopsyInputEligibilityCondition: only after v5 selected.pt is frozen

TRAINING_SOURCE.policy: New training-source videos captured for V5 may be train eligible only after source audit, exact alias checks, deterministic candidate-pool staging, manual annotation, QA, and freeze. They are never development validation, checkpoint-selection, observed-reference, or final-test sources.

TRAIN_ELIGIBLE_EXISTING.policy: May be used as historical train base or future candidate-supply source only if manifests/source-role freezes preserve train eligibility.

scientificBoundary.note: Strict final-test blindness is retired for the former V5 final test after categorical GT-derived metadata exposure.
